study_identification_part.si_4_title: Revealing Individual Neuroanatomical Heterogeneity in Alzheimer Disease Using Neuroanatomical Normative Modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses two main data sources: (1) a reference data set (n=33,072) compiled from multiple publicly available sources including OASIS, ABCD, and UK Biobank among others detailed in eTable 1 (Kia et al.), acquired across 60 sites; (2) a clinical target data set from ADNI (n=1,492) acquired across 62 sites. The reference data set composition is described in detail in Kia et al. (ref 27) and summarized in eTable 1 (not available in this paper). OASIS, ABCD, and UK Biobank are explicitly named; additional datasets in the reference set are unspecified in this paper. MULTI-DATASET is assigned because the reference data set combines 9 or more data sets across 60 sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The reference data set was made by combining data on healthy people from multiple publicly available sources, including OASIS, Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study, and UKB, detailed in eTable 1" ... "The clinical data used in the preparation of this article were obtained from the ADNI database." ... "In the reference data set, a total of n = 33,072 T1-weighted MRI scans were collated across 60 sites (this sample is described in detail in Kia et al. and summarized in eTable 1)"
